physics-killer-05.title: Wani abu mai nauyin
physics-killer-05.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-killer-05.material: Wani abu mai nauyin $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ yana motsi a hanyar $+x$ da gudun $4\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Ƙarfi a hanyar $+x$ yana aiki a kan wannan abu; girman ƙarfin yana ƙaruwa a hankali daga $0$ zuwa $40\,\mathrm{N}$ a tsawon lokaci $0\sim0.1\,\mathrm{s}$, yana tsayawa a $40\,\mathrm{N}$ a tsawon $0.1\sim0.3\,\mathrm{s}$, kuma yana raguwa a hankali daga $40\,\mathrm{N}$ zuwa $0$ a tsawon $0.3\sim0.4\,\mathrm{s}$. Wane zaɓi ne ya haɗa daidai, bi da bi, girman impulse da abu ya samu a tsawon $0.4\,\mathrm{s}$ da wannan ƙarfi ya yi aiki, da gudun abu nan da nan bayan ƙarfin ya ɓace? (Babu wani ƙarfi.)
physics-killer-05.s.s1.prompt: Wani abu mai nauyin $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ yana motsi a hanyar $+x$ da gudun $4\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Ƙarfi a hanyar $+x$ yana aiki a kan wannan abu; girman ƙarfin yana ƙaruwa a hankali daga $0$ zuwa $40\,\mathrm{N}$ a tsawon lokaci $0\sim0.1\,\mathrm{s}$, yana tsayawa a $40\,\mathrm{N}$ a tsawon $0.1\sim0.3\,\mathrm{s}$, kuma yana raguwa a hankali daga $40\,\mathrm{N}$ zuwa $0$ a tsawon $0.3\sim0.4\,\mathrm{s}$. Wane zaɓi ne ya haɗa daidai, bi da bi, girman impulse da abu ya samu a tsawon $0.4\,\mathrm{s}$ da wannan ƙarfi ya yi aiki, da gudun abu nan da nan bayan ƙarfin ya ɓace? (Babu wani ƙarfi.)
physics-killer-05.s.s1.explain: Faɗin yanki: triangle na farko $\frac12\cdot0.1\cdot40=2$, rectangle $0.2\cdot40=8$, triangle na ƙarshe $2$, don haka $I=12\,\mathrm{N\cdot s}$. Daga $I=m(v-v_0)$, $12=2(v-4)\Rightarrow v=10\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Idan aka ɗauki dukan jadawalin a matsayin rectangle $40\cdot0.4=16$ sai amsa mara kyau ②; idan aka bar sassan triangle aka ɗauki $8$ sai amsa mara kyau ③; idan ba a raba $I$ da yawan abu ba aka yi $4+12=16$ sai amsa mara kyau ④.

physics-killer-05.steps.0.prompt: Wani abu mai nauyin $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ yana motsi a hanyar $+x$ da gudun $4\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Ƙarfi a hanyar $+x$ yana aiki a kan wannan abu; girman ƙarfin yana ƙaruwa a hankali daga $0$ zuwa $40\,\mathrm{N}$ a tsawon lokaci $0\sim0.1\,\mathrm{s}$, yana tsayawa a $40\,\mathrm{N}$ a tsawon $0.1\sim0.3\,\mathrm{s}$, kuma yana raguwa a hankali daga $40\,\mathrm{N}$ zuwa $0$ a tsawon $0.3\sim0.4\,\mathrm{s}$. Wane zaɓi ne ya haɗa daidai, bi da bi, girman impulse da abu ya samu a tsawon $0.4\,\mathrm{s}$ da wannan ƙarfi ya yi aiki, da gudun abu nan da nan bayan ƙarfin ya ɓace? (Babu wani ƙarfi.)
